metadata.title: Prefect DAG — End-to-End ML Data Pipeline

nodes.objective: Bring raw data into the run
inputs: Source path(s) on Drive or external source

nodes.notes: Row/col counts, dtypes, missingness, target presence; fail fast on schema/target issues
Ties data, features, env, params to <version>
Accuracy and classification report; include confusion-matrix metrics if applicable
Single place to link in your report

run_characteristics: Versioned runs (timestamped <version>) for lineage and reproducibility
Observability via Prefect task logs + JSON artifacts (validation, metrics, manifest, summary)
Reliability: retries on I/O-prone steps; fail-fast validation prevents wasted training
Portability: Colab-friendly; storage defaults to Drive but can point to GCS/BigQuery later
one_paragraph_summary: The pipeline is orchestrated with Prefect 2, enforcing a strict dependency order—Ingest → Validate → Prepare → Feature Store → Version Snapshot → Train → Evaluate → Publish—to move data from raw inputs to deploy-ready model artifacts. Each flow run is versioned with a timestamp, producing a complete, reproducible snapshot of features, model, metrics, and a manifest under artifacts/<version>/. Validation is fail-fast, training and evaluation are observable via Prefect logs and JSON metrics, and a concise run summary consolidates links to all outputs for reporting and audit.
